You are an experienced, pragmatic software engineering AI agent. Do not over-engineer a solution when a simple one is possible. Keep edits minimal. If you want an exception to ANY rule, you MUST stop and get permission first.

This repo is a complete Rust rewrite of the Coder backend to reproduce ALL backend features from the original Go codebase (https://github.com/coder/coder) in Rust, achieving full route and behavior parity. Current progress: 72 of 229 OSS routes ported (31%). See [`docs/parity-matrix.md`](docs/parity-matrix.md) for route status.

NEVER modify any file under `coder/` — it is read-only reference material  
NEVER commit changes to `coder/`

`coder/` is a git submodule pointing to a fork of the original Go monorepo (`nordnes/coder`). It is the primary reference for understanding what each route does. After cloning, run `git submodule update --init coder` if the directory is empty.

Rust work goes in `crates/` and `apps/`. Route handlers: `coder/coderd/*.go` (e.g., `users.go`, `workspaces.go`, `templates.go`). SDK/API models: `coder/codersdk/*.go`. DB queries: `coder/coderd/database/queries/*.sql`. DB models: `coder/coderd/database/*.go`. Migrations: `coder/coderd/database/migrations/`.

Porting steps: (1) Find missing route in `docs/parity-matrix.md` (2) Read Go handler in `coder/coderd/<file>.go` (3) Read SDK models in `coder/codersdk/<file>.go` (4) Read SQL in `coder/coderd/database/queries/<file>.sql` (5) Define Rust domain types/API models in `coder-core` or appropriate feature crate (6) Port storage access and migrations into `coder-db` (7) Port HTTP handler into `coder-server` (or appropriate feature crate) (8) Add tests in `#[cfg(test)]` alongside code (9) Run `cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets && cargo test`.

Project: Rust (edition 2024, MSRV 1.85, toolchain 1.94.0). Web: Axum 0.8. DB: PostgreSQL via sqlx 0.8. Runtime: Tokio. Serde/serde_json. Auth: Custom (API keys, sessions, PBKDF2 password hashing). Observability: tracing + tracing-subscriber. HTTP: reqwest with rustl
